Changelog

4.3 November 20, 2026

  • Significant performance improvements from fresh optimized re-translation and reimplementation of unoptimized areas. The ARM64 build now outperforms the original ARMv7 build, and the current ARMv7 build also gains a performance boost.
  • Holding the camera button now enters character look camera mode.
  • Fixed pause button desynchronization.
  • Gamepad improvements based on forum feedback.
  • Fixed dark theme button color inconsistencies.
  • Fixed animation buffer sizes.
  • Fixed HDR luminance support.
  • Fixed missing textures and materials in several target modules.
  • Fixed item resizing in trading in certain modules.
  • Fixed extended orders navigation in touch controls.
  • Fixed incorrect fog shader blending.
  • Initial basic module support: A World of Ice and Fire, 1860s Old America, 1257AD - Enhanced Edition and Rome at War. Some modules need patches applied from the Patches menu.
  • Version unification: the game and M&BTool are now both version 4.3.

4.2 November 10, 2026

  • In auto-directional mode, holding a shield now lets the camera move.
  • New touch button to switch shields.
  • Fixed shader alpha channel and transparency issues.
  • Character import and export restored.
  • Multiplayer: fixed on ARMv8.
  • Multiplayer: LAN cross-play with PC 1.174.
  • Multiplayer: initial support for the Persistent World mod.
  • Fixed user-reported crashes and issues.
  • Improved first-time installation instructions.
  • Improved localizations.
  • Fixed rare textures with corrupted mipmaps.
  • Fixed the font compression setting for native DXT textures.
  • Slight performance improvements from optimized re-translation.
  • Orders and groups: custom orders and multi-order bindings.
  • Orders: command different groups with your voice through Android speech-to-text, fully localized.
  • Fixed missing button-key discovery; custom keys can now be added.
  • Ctrl and Shift keys now behave as expected.
  • More custom buttons, icon customization and row alignment.
  • Modules: launcher.csv translation support.
  • Modules: touch.csv color, icon and position customization.
  • Modules: custom engine mods can ship inside a module's mods folder.
  • Debug overlay: temperature, ping and CPU throttling.
  • Smooth Tree LODs mod: fixed instant transitions.
  • The custom folder selector now uses Android's Storage Access Framework.

4.1 October 27, 2026

  • Static recompilation powered by ARMPORT for native performance.
  • Fixed zoom issues.
  • Fixed HDR exposure of town names.
  • Uncompressed font textures as an option.
  • Fixed the night sky in the Live Sky mod corrupting shadows.
  • Fast Loading mod: multithreaded shader compilation and a shader cache.
  • Improved TAA anti-flickering.
  • Fixed live trees repositioning on the map.
  • Touch assist for more accurate taps; fixed map rotation with the mouse.
  • Fixed the pause button not always being shown.
  • One more camera control option, off by default, like ~ on PC.
  • Better trading and hover experience.
  • Adjustable fast travel speed.
  • Right-to-left localization support and advanced language features.
  • Fixed shadow pixelation.
  • Save data safeguards and thread safety.
  • Engine parity: features found in 1.168 and some changes from 1.173, plus a separate opcode parity mod. Engine parity is off by default for now.
  • Tree LOD parameters were configured backwards; fixed in the presets.
  • Fixed character shadows appearing instantly.
  • Fixed scene fades and the frame drops during them.
  • Initial compatibility fixes for the TLD and SOTT modules.
  • Fixed uninitialized lighting in notes.
  • On-device text-to-speech, and speech-to-text in chat.
  • Library for mods, localizations and servers.
  • Demanding core engine functions rewritten and optimized for better performance.
  • Controls configuration compatibility fixes and improvements from user feedback, plus a new tap-to-choose-direction mode.
  • UI widget for gamma, contrast and brightness.
  • Multiplayer maps can be played in Custom Battle.
  • More changes I forgot to mention.

New game translations in the library: Arabic, Portuguese, Hebrew, Indonesian, Italian, Korean, Persian, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. A custom AI translation tool for other languages is in beta.

Multiplayer may not work correctly in the ARMv8 version yet, and trade preview numbers may be wrong; this will be addressed in the next version.

4.0 October 11, 2026

  • Controls: dynamic, customizable touchscreen controls, plus gamepad and keyboard-and-mouse support. The trading menu can move all items and cancel purchases.
  • Combat: directional attack and defense controls, with adjustable aiming sensitivity.
  • Modules and mods: third-party modules with the same folder structure as on PC, and numerous compatibility fixes. Newer mods and those relying on WSE (Warband Script Enhancer) may not work.
  • Localization: module translations work out of the box, without conversion. An optional built-in Russian translation for Native, and AI-powered translation.
  • Voice acting: localized voice acting restored.
  • Textures: texture caching for faster loading, or conversion on every launch. ASTC, ETC2 and ETC1 formats, with a configurable maximum texture size.
  • Texture streaming: textures stream in dynamically, cutting memory use by almost 50%. Very large textures load on devices powerful enough for them.
  • Rendering: longer draw distance and fewer visual artifacts through 24-bit depth buffers and framebuffer improvements; optimized shader precision.
  • Graphics settings: game configuration through an interface, including graphics presets.
  • Map controls: free camera movement on the world map, a camera-follow mode, and a pause button that can be pinned to the screen.
  • Movement and feedback: crouching, slow walking, smooth aiming, and vibration when taking damage.
  • Restored assets: footprints, the compass, control sticks, and other missing textures and materials.
  • HDR and post-processing: skybox-based HDR, full restoration of PostFX effects, and HDR display support on compatible devices. HDR10 significantly reduces FPS.
  • Lighting: gamma, fog and lighting restored to match the PC version.
  • World: clouds, wind and stars make the world feel more alive; each can be toggled like other mods.
  • Bug fixes: all memory leaks found in the original game are fixed, and an audit of the game fixed dozens of bugs.
  • Shadows and vegetation: accurate shadows across the entire map, with smooth loading of trees and grass.
  • Performance: faster loading, better performance of world map actions, and smoother long scene transitions.
  • Low-end devices: optimizations for weaker devices, including a custom rendering resolution.
  • TAA: temporal anti-aliasing can be turned on or off, with adjustable resolution.
  • Russian translation: checked for errors and corrected, with font support.
  • More languages: localizations for the languages the game ships with, plus a localized launcher. Game text: English, Czech, French, German, Hungarian, Japanese, Polish, Russian, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish and Turkish; the launcher in 20 languages.
  • Touchscreen customization: three button themes with adjustable transparency and positions, and additional buttons.
  • Saves: backup and restore, and your location shown on the map.
  • Multiplayer and interface: multiplayer support, adjustable interface proportions, and an FPS monitoring menu.
  • Custom mods: install custom mods directly from device storage.

3.1 September 18, 2021

  • Mod 3.1: added sharedUserId, so another app can change the game's configuration; designed for unpacking textures without virtual machines.
  • M&BTool 1.2: added sharedUserId; the Russian translation archive now includes unpacked font textures.

3.0 July 10, 2021

  • Press both volume keys (+/−) at once to show the keyboard.
  • Fullscreen mode, free of the display cutout and on-screen buttons.
  • The Back action is now on the Select button.
  • Fixed resource loading in mods: the original game combines two cache paths, because on PC the resources are nested.

2.2 June 12, 2021

  • Fixed saving with Save As, which broke when the keyboard was shown. Every attempt to show or hide the keyboard now does nothing.

2.1 June 5, 2021

  • Fixed the freeze when tapping the character name while creating a new game. The name can't be changed yet, but the game no longer freezes and can be started.

2.0 May 29, 2021

  • The cache is read from /sdcard/mnb/ to get around Android 11's restrictions on /Android/data/. Mostly adapted for the VirtualXposed and SandVXposed virtual machines.

1.0 May 15, 2021

  • Initial experimental mod that moves the OBB cache into a game directory.
M&BTool is an unofficial fan project, made by fans for fans.
